cohort: The study included 101 mothers (aged 18-40 years) with singleton fetuses delivered preterm (28-36 weeks 6 days gestation) as cases, matched with mothers of two consecutive term births as controls.
finding: Parity and various pregnancy complications, including anemia, hypertension, fetal growth restriction, oligohydramnios, antepartum hemorrhage, and PPROM, were identified as significant risk factors associated with preterm labor.
